prompt: Write part of a deposition transcript (about 400 words) of a plaintiff in a car accident lawsuit. The defense lawyer asks (lines start with 'Q:') and the plaintiff answers (lines start with 'A:'). Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. Injury: back strain. Ask about the accident, treatment and daily life. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the record for this part. You can use the placeholder plaintiff.

Q: That's fine, we'll note the placeholder. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on the frontage road in League City, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. I was in the right-hand lane.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had signaled and was moving into the center lane because I needed to turn left at the next light. I checked my mirror and the lane looked clear.

Q: What happened next?
A: The other vehicle came up on my left and its side clipped mine as it moved over. I heard a scrape and felt my car shove to the right. I pulled over onto the shoulder after I got control of the wheel.

Q: Did you have any pain at the scene?
A: Not right away. I was shaken up, and I remember my lower back feeling tight, but I figured it was adrenaline. By the next morning it was a sharp ache across the low back.

Q: Who did you see for treatment after the accident?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same week, and then I was referred to a physical therapist. I've been going a few times a week since then.

Q: What did the treatment involve?
A: Heat, some stretching exercises, and manual therapy on my back. They also gave me a home exercise sheet, which I try to do most days.

Q: How has the injury affected your daily life?
A: Sitting for long periods is hard. I used to coach my nephew's soccer team on weekends, and I had to hand that off to my brother. Lifting groceries and bending to load the dishwasher bother me, so my wife does most of that now.

Q: Have you missed any work?
A: I missed a few days at the start. Since then I've been on modified duties, so I stand up every half hour and I'm not lifting heavy boxes like I used to.

Q: Have you had any prior back problems?
A: I had some stiffness years ago after a fall at home, but it resolved and I didn't need treatment for it. Before this accident I was not seeing any doctor for my back.
